name: Treated effluent must meet prescribed discharge/reuse standards before release or reuse
Effluent/water flow meters must be calibrated and log maintained
Valid CTO must be held and renewed before expiry for water-related discharge
Self-assessed water consumption cess return, where applicable
Stack emissions from DG sets must remain within CPCB/SPCB notified limits
Boiler stack emissions must remain within prescribed limits
Ambient air quality at site boundary must meet National Ambient Air Quality Standards
DG set stack height must meet CPCB norm relative to DG capacity/building height
Valid CTO must be held and renewed for air-emission sources
Annual environmental statement summarizing water/air/waste performance must be filed
Bore-well water extraction requires CGWA No-Objection Certificate and periodic reporting
Hazardous waste must not be stored beyond the permitted duration without SPCB extension
Used oil from DG sets must be handed over to an authorized recycler with a manifest
Hazardous waste must be segregated by category and labelled per Schedule III
Valid Rule 6 authorization must be held and renewed
Solid waste must be segregated at source into wet, dry and domestic-hazardous streams
Registration as a bulk waste generator with the local body, with a waste management plan on file
On-site wet waste processing (composting/biogas) volumes must be logged where mandated
Boundary noise levels must remain within notified day/night limits for the applicable zone
DG sets must be housed in acoustic enclosures maintained to manufacturer/CPCB spec
Identified single-use plastic items (notified list) must not be used or distributed on-site
Plastic packaging use must be registered on the CPCB EPR portal with an annual return
End-of-life electronics must be handed to an authorized dismantler/recycler with a manifest
Used lead-acid/other batteries must be returned to an authorized collection agency
Bio-medical waste must be segregated into colour-coded bags/containers per category
Waste must be handed to the Common Bio-medical Waste Treatment Facility with a barcoded manifest
On-site autoclaving, where used, must meet validated time/temperature/pressure parameters
Valid Rule 10 authorization must be held and renewed
A waste management plan must be filed and executed for renovation/demolition activity
